<script src="https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-2.35.2.min.js"></script>
<script>
let PERFORMANCE_DATA=[];let APPLIED_DATA=[];let COLUMNS={};

function clean(value){
  if(value===null||value===undefined)
    return "";
  return String(value).trim();
}

function number(value){
  if(value===null||value===undefined||value==="")return null;
  const n=Number(String(value).replace(/,/g,"").trim());
  return Number.isFinite(n)?n:null;
}

function normalizeHeader(value){
  return clean(value).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,"");
}

function cssVar(name){
  return getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue(name).trim();
}

function findColumn(rows,possibleNames){
  if(!rows.length)return null;
  const headers=Object.keys(rows[0]);
  const normalized=headers.map(h=>({raw:h,norm:normalizeHeader(h)}));
  for(const name of possibleNames){
    const target=normalizeHeader(name);
    const match=normalized.find(h=>h.norm===target);
    if(match)return match.raw;
  }
  return null;
}

function getColumns(rows){
  return{
    glider:findColumn(rows,["glider"]),
    mode:findColumn(rows,["mode"]),
    wh_km:findColumn(rows,["W h per km"]),
    watts:findColumn(rows,["Watts"]),
    vertical_speed:findColumn(rows,["median |vert speed| m/s"]),
    dive_duration:findColumn(rows,["median dive h"]),
    max_depth:findColumn(rows,["median max depth m","deepest in mode m"]),
    distance:findColumn(rows,["km/dive"]),
    wh_dive:findColumn(rows,["W h/dive"]),
    pump_moves:findColumn(rows,["pump moves per hour"]),
    pump_dives_counted:findColumn(rows,["pump dives counted"]),
    pump_volume:findColumn(rows,["cc pumped per hour"])
  };
}

const PLOT_COLORS={};
let GLIDER_COLOR_MAP={};

function gliderColor(name){
  let hash=0;
  for(let i=0;i<name.length;i++)
    hash=(hash*31+name.charCodeAt(i))>>>0;
  const hue=hash%360;
  return `hsl(${hue},65%,45%)`;
}

function buildGliderColors(){
  const gliders=[...new Set(PERFORMANCE_DATA.map(r=>clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])).filter(Boolean))];
  GLIDER_COLOR_MAP={};
  gliders.forEach(g=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[g]=gliderColor(g));
}

function refreshPlotColors(){
  PLOT_COLORS.ink=cssVar("--ink")||"#1F2C31";
  PLOT_COLORS.ink2=cssVar("--ink-2")||"#536268";
  PLOT_COLORS.ink3=cssVar("--ink-3")||"#78888E";
  PLOT_COLORS.line=cssVar("--line")||"#DAE3E5";
  PLOT_COLORS.lineStrong=cssVar("--line-strong")||"#BCCBCE";
  PLOT_COLORS.accent=cssVar("--accent")||"#2780E3";
}

const plotConfig={responsive:true,displayModeBar:false};

function plotLayout(xTitle,yTitle){
  return{
    height:320,
    margin:{l:65,r:20,t:10,b:55},
    paper_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font:{family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible, Arial, sans-serif",color:PLOT_COLORS.ink},
    xaxis:{title:xTitle,gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line,zerolinecolor:PLOT_COLORS.lineStrong},
    yaxis:{title:yTitle,gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line,zerolinecolor:PLOT_COLORS.lineStrong},
    hovermode:"closest"
  };
}

function clearChart(id){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(el)el.innerHTML="";
}

function showChartMessage(id,message){
  const el=document.getElementById(id);
  if(el)el.innerHTML=`<div class="empty">${message}</div>`;
}

function validXY(rows,xCol,yCol){
  return rows.map(r=>({
    x:number(r[xCol]),
    y:number(r[yCol]),
    glider:clean(r[COLUMNS.glider]),
    mode:clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])
  })).filter(d=>d.x!==null&&d.y!==null);
}

async function loadPerformanceData(){
  const status=document.getElementById("performance-count");
  status.textContent="Loading performance data…";

  try{
    const response=await fetch("data/glider_performance_summary.csv");
    if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`Could not load CSV (${response.status} ${response.statusText})`);

    const csvText=await response.text();
    const lines=csvText.trim().split(/\r?\n/);
    const headers=lines[0].split(",").map(h=>h.trim());

    PERFORMANCE_DATA=lines.slice(1).map(line=>{
      const values=line.split(",");
      const row={};
      headers.forEach((header,i)=>row[header]=values[i]!==undefined?values[i].trim():"");
      return row;
    }).filter(row=>Object.values(row).some(value=>clean(value)!==""));

    if(!PERFORMANCE_DATA.length)throw new Error("The CSV loaded, but contains no data rows.");

    COLUMNS=getColumns(PERFORMANCE_DATA);
    console.log("Rows loaded:",PERFORMANCE_DATA.length);
    console.log("Detected columns:",COLUMNS);
    buildGliderColors();
    populateFilters();
    APPLIED_DATA=PERFORMANCE_DATA.slice();
    refreshPlotColors();
    renderDashboard();
  }catch(error){
    console.error("PERFORMANCE DASHBOARD ERROR:",error);
    status.innerHTML=`<span style="color:var(--flag);">Unable to load performance data: ${error.message}</span>`;
  }
}

function populateFilters(){
  const gliderSelect=document.getElementById("glider-select");
  const modeSelect=document.getElementById("mode-select");
  const gliders=[...new Set(PERFORMANCE_DATA.map(r=>clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  const modes=[...new Set(PERFORMANCE_DATA.map(r=>clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])).filter(Boolean))].sort();

  gliders.forEach(g=>{
    const option=document.createElement("option");
    option.value=g;
    option.textContent=g;
    gliderSelect.appendChild(option);
  });

  modes.forEach(m=>{
    const option=document.createElement("option");
    option.value=m;
    option.textContent=m;
    modeSelect.appendChild(option);
  });

  gliderSelect.options[0].selected=true;
  modeSelect.options[0].selected=true;
}

function getFilteredData(){
  const gliderSelect=document.getElementById("glider-select");
  const modeSelect=document.getElementById("mode-select");

  const selectedGliders=[...gliderSelect.selectedOptions].map(option=>option.value);
  const selectedModes=[...modeSelect.selectedOptions].map(option=>option.value);

  const allGliders=selectedGliders.includes("all")||selectedGliders.length===0;
  const allModes=selectedModes.includes("all")||selectedModes.length===0;

  return APPLIED_DATA.filter(r=>
    (allGliders||selectedGliders.includes(clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])))&&
    (allModes||selectedModes.includes(clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])))
  );
}

function renderWhKm(rows){
  clearChart("chart-whkm");

  const data=rows.map(r=>({
    name:`${clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])} — ${clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])}`,
    glider:clean(r[COLUMNS.glider]),
    value:number(r[COLUMNS.wh_km])
  })).filter(d=>d.value!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.value-b.value);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-whkm","No energy-efficiency data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-whkm",[{
    type:"bar",
    orientation:"h",
    x:data.map(d=>d.value),
    y:data.map(d=>d.name),
    text:data.map(d=>d.value.toFixed(2)),
    textposition:"outside",
    marker:{color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],{
    height:Math.max(320,data.length*28),
    margin:{l:150,r:55,t:10,b:50},
    paper_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font:{family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible, Arial, sans-serif",color:PLOT_COLORS.ink},
    xaxis:{title:"Wh/km",gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line,zerolinecolor:PLOT_COLORS.lineStrong},
    yaxis:{automargin:true}
  },plotConfig);
}

function renderPowerSpeed(rows){
  clearChart("chart-power-speed");

  const data=validXY(rows,COLUMNS.vertical_speed,COLUMNS.watts);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-power-speed","No power/vertical-speed data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-power-speed",[{
    type:"scatter",
    mode:"markers",
    x:data.map(d=>d.x),
    y:data.map(d=>d.y),
    text:data.map(d=>`${d.glider} — ${d.mode}`),
    hovertemplate:"%{text}<br>Vertical speed: %{x:.3f} m/s<br>Power: %{y:.2f} W<extra></extra>",
    marker:{size:10,color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],plotLayout("Median |vertical speed| (m/s)","Power (W)"),plotConfig);
}

function renderDurationDepth(rows){
  clearChart("chart-duration-depth");

  const data=validXY(rows,COLUMNS.dive_duration,COLUMNS.max_depth);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-duration-depth","No dive-duration/depth data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-duration-depth",[{
    type:"scatter",
    mode:"markers",
    x:data.map(d=>d.x),
    y:data.map(d=>d.y),
    text:data.map(d=>`${d.glider} — ${d.mode}`),
    hovertemplate:"%{text}<br>Dive duration: %{x:.2f} hr<br>Maximum depth: %{y:.0f} m<extra></extra>",
    marker:{size:10,color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],plotLayout("Median dive duration (hr)","Median maximum depth (m)"),plotConfig);
}

function renderDistanceEnergy(rows){
  clearChart("chart-distance-energy");

  const data=validXY(rows,COLUMNS.distance,COLUMNS.wh_dive);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-distance-energy","No distance/energy data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-distance-energy",[{
    type:"scatter",
    mode:"markers",
    x:data.map(d=>d.x),
    y:data.map(d=>d.y),
    text:data.map(d=>`${d.glider} — ${d.mode}`),
    hovertemplate:"%{text}<br>Distance: %{x:.2f} km/dive<br>Energy: %{y:.2f} Wh/dive<extra></extra>",
    marker:{size:10,color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],plotLayout("Distance per dive (km)","Energy per dive (Wh)"),plotConfig);
}

function renderPumpPower(rows){
  clearChart("chart-pump-power");

  const data=validXY(rows,COLUMNS.pump_moves,COLUMNS.pump_dives_counted);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-pump-power","No pump-activity data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-pump-power",[{
    type:"scatter",
    mode:"markers",
    x:data.map(d=>d.x),
    y:data.map(d=>d.y),
    text:data.map(d=>`${d.glider} — ${d.mode}`),
    hovertemplate:"%{text}<br>Pump moves: %{x:.0f} / hr<br>Pumped dives counted: %{y:.0f}<extra></extra>",
    marker:{size:10,color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],plotLayout("Pump moves per hour","Pumped dives counted"),plotConfig);
}

function renderWatts(rows){
  clearChart("chart-watts");

  const data=rows.map(r=>({
    name:`${clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])} — ${clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])}`,
    glider:clean(r[COLUMNS.glider]),
    value:number(r[COLUMNS.watts])
  })).filter(d=>d.value!==null).sort((a,b)=>a.value-b.value);

  if(!data.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-watts","No power data available.");
    return;
  }

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-watts",[{
    type:"bar",
    orientation:"h",
    x:data.map(d=>d.value),
    y:data.map(d=>d.name),
    text:data.map(d=>d.value.toFixed(2)),
    textposition:"outside",
    marker:{color:data.map(d=>GLIDER_COLOR_MAP[d.glider])}
  }],{
    height:Math.max(320,data.length*28),
    margin:{l:150,r:55,t:10,b:50},
    paper_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font:{family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible, Arial, sans-serif",color:PLOT_COLORS.ink},
    xaxis:{title:"Power (W)",gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line,zerolinecolor:PLOT_COLORS.lineStrong},
    yaxis:{automargin:true}
  },plotConfig);
}

function renderHeatmap(rows){
  clearChart("chart-heatmap");

  const metric=document.getElementById("metric-select").value;
  const gliders=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])).filter(Boolean))].sort();
  const modes=[...new Set(rows.map(r=>clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])).filter(Boolean))].sort();

  if(!gliders.length||!modes.length){
    showChartMessage("chart-heatmap","No data available for the selected filters.");
    return;
  }

  const matrix=gliders.map(g=>modes.map(m=>{
    const values=rows.filter(r=>
      clean(r[COLUMNS.glider])===g&&
      clean(r[COLUMNS.mode])===m
    ).map(r=>number(r[COLUMNS[metric]])).filter(v=>v!==null);

    return values.length?values.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/values.length:null;
  }));

  const labels={
    wh_km:"Wh/km",
    watts:"Power (W)",
    wh_dive:"Wh/dive",
    distance:"km/dive",
    dive_duration:"Dive duration (hr)",
    vertical_speed:"Vertical speed (m/s)"
  };

  document.getElementById("heatmap-label").textContent=labels[metric]||metric;

  Plotly.newPlot("chart-heatmap",[{
    type:"heatmap",
    z:matrix,
    x:modes,
    y:gliders,
    colorscale:"Blues",
    hovertemplate:"Glider: %{y}<br>Mode: %{x}<br>Value: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>",
    colorbar:{title:labels[metric]||metric}
  }],{
    height:Math.max(320,gliders.length*42+100),
    margin:{l:90,r:30,t:10,b:80},
    paper_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor:"rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font:{family:"Atkinson Hyperlegible, Arial, sans-serif",color:PLOT_COLORS.ink},
    xaxis:{title:"Mode",gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line},
    yaxis:{title:"Glider",gridcolor:PLOT_COLORS.line}
  },plotConfig);
}

function renderTable(rows){
  const thead=document.getElementById("performance-thead");
  const tbody=document.getElementById("performance-tbody");

  thead.innerHTML="";
  tbody.innerHTML="";

  const columns=[
    COLUMNS.glider,
    COLUMNS.mode,
    COLUMNS.wh_km,
    COLUMNS.watts,
    COLUMNS.vertical_speed,
    COLUMNS.dive_duration,
    COLUMNS.max_depth,
    COLUMNS.distance,
    COLUMNS.wh_dive
  ].filter(Boolean);

  const headerRow=document.createElement("tr");

  columns.forEach(c=>{
    const th=document.createElement("th");
    th.textContent=c;
    headerRow.appendChild(th);
  });

  thead.appendChild(headerRow);

  rows.forEach(r=>{
    const tr=document.createElement("tr");

    columns.forEach(c=>{
      const td=document.createElement("td");
      td.textContent=clean(r[c]);
      tr.appendChild(td);
    });

    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
}

function renderSummary(rows){
  document.getElementById("performance-count").textContent=`${rows.length} glider/mode combinations`;
}

function renderDashboard(){
  const rows=getFilteredData();
  renderSummary(rows);
  renderPowerSpeed(rows);
  renderDurationDepth(rows);
  renderDistanceEnergy(rows);
  renderPumpPower(rows);
  renderWhKm(rows);
  renderWatts(rows);
  renderHeatmap(rows);
  renderTable(rows);
}

function applyPerformanceFilters(){
  APPLIED_DATA=PERFORMANCE_DATA.slice();
  renderDashboard();
  document.getElementById("performance-status").hidden=true;
}

function resetPerformanceFilters(){
  const gliderSelect=document.getElementById("glider-select");
  const modeSelect=document.getElementById("mode-select");

  [...gliderSelect.options].forEach(option=>option.selected=false);
  [...modeSelect.options].forEach(option=>option.selected=false);

  gliderSelect.options[0].selected=true;
  modeSelect.options[0].selected=true;

  document.getElementById("metric-select").value="wh_km";
  document.getElementById("view-gliders").click();
  APPLIED_DATA=PERFORMANCE_DATA.slice();
  renderDashboard();
  document.getElementById("performance-status").hidden=true;
}

function markPerformanceDirty(){
  document.getElementById("performance-status").hidden=false;
}

document.getElementById("apply-performance").addEventListener("click",applyPerformanceFilters);
document.getElementById("reset-performance").addEventListener("click",resetPerformanceFilters);
document.getElementById("glider-select").addEventListener("change",markPerformanceDirty);
document.getElementById("mode-select").addEventListener("change",markPerformanceDirty);
document.getElementById("metric-select").addEventListener("change",markPerformanceDirty);

document.getElementById("view-gliders").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  document.getElementById("view-gliders").setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");
  document.getElementById("view-modes").setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
});

document.getElementById("view-modes").addEventListener("click",()=>{
  document.getElementById("view-gliders").setAttribute("aria-pressed","false");
  document.getElementById("view-modes").setAttribute("aria-pressed","true");
});

loadPerformanceData();
</script>
